dict.string: TreeletHub advertises on your local network so iPhones on the same Wi‑Fi can discover and pair with this Mac.
TreeletHub needs Screen Recording access to invoke the system screenshot tool for screenshot shortcuts.
TreeletHub uses Apple Events to control ChatGPT, Codex, and Cursor from your iPhone, and to read Music now-playing metadata for Dynamic Island.
TreeletHub listens for Control and key presses to show the Keyboard Launcher overlay and open mapped apps.
TreeletHub uses your approximate location to show local weather and forecasts through WeatherKit.
